The 1H MACD histogram completed its bullish cross to +15.08 after four improving bars. Holding a short into that combination is fighting the tape for a hedge whose premise has expired. Gates are unchanged in method and re-sized to the smaller 263.94 hourly ATR.

The pool below is larger (2,274,813 against 2,140,827 USD) and more one-sidedly long (78.8 against 77.4 percent), but the pool above is 56.8 points CLOSER (96.6 points up against 153.4 points down) and funding at -0.00332 percent says shorts are the side currently paying to stay in. scalpContext.intradayBias: Coiled with a mild upward tilt, and the coil is now the dominant fact. Four consecutive ATR contractions have taken hourly range down 57.9 percent from Friday's spike and the 15-minute ATR to the week's lowest reading; the last six 15m bars fit inside 94 points. The 1H MACD has crossed positive and funding is nearly four times more negative than it was at midnight, both of which argue the first expansion attempt is upward. But 79,773.7 already failed once this morning and open interest bled another 25.7m USD, so the probe that failed was thin. Trade the edges of the box, expect the resolution rather than the range, and respect a weekend book that cannot absorb size.

calibration.note: A clean session for the framework on both the gates and the direction. Midnight called for the first expansion attempt to be UPWARD toward the 79,750 pocket and the 1H EMA20 stacked above it; price did exactly that, printing 79,773.7 straight through the pocket - and then failed to hold it, which is why the add gate declining to arm was the correct outcome rather than a missed trade. That is now FIVE consecutive sessions in which a settled-close gate placed roughly 0.5 hourly ATRs beyond a proven wick has correctly refused to arm on a touch, and the spacing is kept unchanged this run for that reason. The discretionary side also worked: the midnight decision to HALVE rather than close the short hedge was right for five hours - price is 34.7 points below the midnight mark, so the residual 15 USD short is fractionally green - but the reasoning behind keeping any of it has now expired, which is what this session acts on.
